provider: Synthesized locally with SoX 14.4 and encoded with FFmpeg libvorbis (q 5). No external service or sample library. Loudness measured with FFmpeg ebur128: heartbeat and swell are normalized to -23 LUFS integrated like the other cues; the two interface droplets, too short for integrated loudness, peak at -25 and -29 LUFS momentary so they sit under gameplay cues.

heartbeat.ogg.use: Critical health: a slow two-beat pulse while the Mother has one organelle left. Harmonics at about 116 and 174 Hz and a soft attack keep it audible on laptop speakers (25% of RMS above 150 Hz, versus 13% for the first version).
commands: sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 lub-f.wav synth 0.22 sine 58:46 fade q 0.006 0.22 0.19
sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 lub-h2.wav synth 0.16 sine 116:92 fade q 0.004 0.16 0.14 gain -5
sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 lub-h3.wav synth 0.10 sine 174:138 fade q 0.003 0.10 0.09 gain -10
sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 lub-click.wav synth 0.018 pinknoise fade q 0.001 0.018 0.016 lowpass 900 gain -14
sox -m lub-f.wav lub-h2.wav lub-h3.wav lub-click.wav lub2.wav
sox lub2.wav dub2.wav pitch -180 gain -4
sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 gap2.wav trim 0 0.11
sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 tail2.wav trim 0 0.55
sox lub2.wav gap2.wav dub2.wav tail2.wav beat2-dry.wav
sox beat2-dry.wav -c 2 heartbeat2.wav gain -10 lowpass 1200 reverb 15 50 50
sox heartbeat2.wav heartbeat-final.wav gain 9.0   # to -23 LUFS integrated

swell.ogg.use: A soft water swell when an encounter opens and when a new dish or boss is introduced.
commands: sox -n -r 44100 -c 2 swell-dry.wav synth 2.2 brownnoise synth 2.2 sine amod 0.35 0
sox swell-dry.wav swell.wav sinc 140-1100 fade q 0.9 2.2 1.1 reverb 40 60 80 gain -n -6
sox swell.wav swell-final.wav gain -0.8   # to -23 LUFS integrated

ui_press.ogg.use: A water-droplet tick when an interface button is pressed.
commands: sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 press-a.wav synth 0.11 sine 480:1250 fade q 0.002 0.11 0.10
sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 press-b.wav synth 0.11 sine 960:2500 fade q 0.002 0.11 0.10 gain -12
sox -m press-a.wav press-b.wav press-dry.wav
sox press-dry.wav -c 2 ui_press.wav gain -10 pad 0 0.10 lowpass 4200 reverb 20 40 50 gain -n -9
sox ui_press.wav ui_press-final.wav gain -6.2   # to -25 LUFS peak momentary

ui_hover.ogg.use: A very quiet, higher droplet when the pointer reaches an enabled button or evolution card.
commands: sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 hover-dry.wav synth 0.06 sine 1400:1750 fade q 0.002 0.06 0.055
sox hover-dry.wav -c 2 ui_hover.wav gain -10 pad 0 0.06 lowpass 5000 reverb 15 40 40 gain -n -18
sox ui_hover.wav ui_hover-final.wav gain -1.8   # to -29 LUFS peak momentary
